[[File:Quadranium.png|thumb|right]]
'''Quadranium''' was an incredibly strong and durable element that was used primarily for the construction of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] fuel tanks. [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] first applied this element to [[droid armor]] during the development of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] designed to clean starship engines and fuel tanks. Quadranium could be forged into a blade, as seen with a [[quadranium edge]].

During the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], quadranium was used to build [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armors]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe||type=item|Quadranium Asylum Armor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' states that [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] had a skin of quadranium steel; however, its skin was composed of [[Quadanium steel/Legends|Quadanium steel]].
